name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 37

clue.text: Slender monarch in a brown study
Left the others at the gate
Club without one allurement
Exactly adapted to fit dog or crazy Oriental
Sent round second note with a piece of news — that’s one’s forte
Be quiet! If coming back happily drunk, you start, evasively
Summary note, very exact
I need a certain size
Cold-blooded creature, going round always too hot...
... has wild desire to live
Quiet goddess in danger is of lesser importance
There’s room in prison for what a betrayer is said to d
The dog to pass on fiction
Puff! Hold the instrument the other way! Getting irritable?
What about egg-head being hesitant to embrace a bird
Bite raised by a fly
Refuse to brood
Once more the good man can’t agree
Monkey about — assume, for the sake of argument, it’s to the purpose?
Writers start maids scurrying
In considerable distress and alarm one is made to go on foot
Without credit, not fit to eat? Too improbable
One who might not acknowledge being less well-built?
Colour-fast — nothing in that could be suggestive
They admit the criminal charge to get treatment
Were no changes made before this time?
